title: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
title_original: 자살예방 및 생명존중문화 조성을 위한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 2 (Designation of Specialized Research Institutions)
① The Minister of Health and Welfare, as well as special governors, metropolitan governors, provincial governors, and special self-governing governors (hereinafter referred to as "governors"), may, in accordance with Article 12(1) of the "Act on the Promotion of Suicide Prevention and the Culture of Respect for Life" (hereinafter referred to as the "Act"), designate the following organizations or entities that meet any of the following criteria as specialized research institutions for the collection, analysis, and management of suicide statistics (hereinafter referred to as "specialized research institutions"): <amended May 30, 2017, December 9, 2022>
1. Public and private research institutions
2. Public and private hospitals
3. Schools as defined in Article 2 of the "Act on Higher Education"
4. Mental health research institutions as defined in Article 16 of the "Act on the Promotion of Mental Health and Support for the Welfare of Persons with Mental Disorders"
4.2. The Korea Respect for Life Foundation as defined in Article 12(4)(1) of the Act
5. Suicide prevention centers as defined in Article 13 of the Act
6. Other organizations or entities with specialized expertise in the collection, analysis, and management of statistics
② The Minister of Health and Welfare, as well as governors, may, in accordance with Article 1 of the Act,

When designating research and investigation institutions, the following matters should be considered:

1. Whether the institution has the necessary expertise in collecting, analyzing, and managing statistics.
2. Whether the institution possesses the necessary organization and personnel.
3. Whether the institution has the necessary security and safety measures suitable for collecting, analyzing, and managing suicide statistics.

(3) The Minister of Health and Welfare and the governors of provinces and municipalities can provide financial support for research and investigation institutions to perform their duties, within the scope of the budget.
